subject: 5 AI Writing Tools That Actually Work

body:
Hey there! Content creation is eating up your time, and AI writing tools are finally good enough to trust with real work. Here are the best options this week for small business owners who need to ship copy faster.

**This Week's Top Picks**

**Notion AI** — Write, summarize, and brainstorm without leaving your workspace. Best for: Teams already using Notion who want AI built into their existing workflow. **Free + $10/mo** — [Try Notion AI Free →](https://notion.so/?ref=YOURCODE)

**Jasper** — Purpose-built AI writing assistant with templates for ads, emails, and landing pages. Best for: Marketing teams cranking out campaigns at scale. **$49/mo** — [Try Jasper Free →](https://jasper.ai/?ref=YOURCODE)

**Copy.ai** — Generates marketing copy in seconds—headlines, social posts, product descriptions. Best for: Solopreneurs and small shops that need quick copy variations tested fast. **Free + $36/mo** — [Try Copy.ai Free →](https://copy.ai/?ref=YOURCODE)

**Quick Tip**

AI writing tools are great at speed but terrible at strategy. Before you ask any tool to write, spend 2 minutes defining: Who am I talking to? What problem am I solving? What do I want them to do? The better your prompt, the less editing you'll do later—and that's where you actually save time.

---

**Bonus mention:** If you're serious about ranking on Google, **Surfer SEO** ($89/mo) does the heavy lifting—it analyzes top-ranking pages in your niche and tells you exactly what your content needs to compete. Pairs perfectly with any writing tool above.

Keep shipping, and don't overthink it—imperfect content published beats perfect content stuck in drafts.
